name: B10-0440/2026 (The Left) – Human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to stop using the death penalty and to release people held only for peaceful protest, including Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani. It asks the European Union to lift sanctions on Iran that harm ordinary people's health, medicines and food. It also criticises the European Union for judging some countries harshly while ignoring abuses by its allies. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament states its position; no law changes and no one is directly affected yet.
- It addresses Iran's authorities, the European Union and its member states.
- The Parliament's President sends the text to European Union bodies, member states and Iran.
